integrity: The theorem and all critical computations are reproduced in RESULT.md and verify.py. The self-review is not independent certification. No proof of a general-width grid enumeration is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only Cartesian products of the six-vertex path with a finite path, under the ordinary closed-neighborhood binary parity rule, are classified. The all-length result relies on a finite 64-case base enumeration plus an exact symbolic recurrence. Claims of historical priority are provisional; the 2002 Graphs and Combinatorics article was accessible only by bibliographic abstract.
title: Complete weight spectrum of even-neighborhood sets on six-row grids
